profile.name: Agent Workspace Cursor Profile
profile.description: Public-safe starter Cursor profile assets for rules, focused subagents, skills guidance, and MCP examples.

notes: User Rules are manually managed in Cursor Settings; this profile does not define a global User Rules file path.
Project Rules are installed to .cursor/rules in explicit project targets.
MCP examples and sandbox profiles are opt-in templates and must be reviewed before use.
Secrets must be supplied via Cursor-supported environment interpolation such as ${env:VARIABLE_NAME}.
